description: List available modules for sale on the module market. Returns listing ID, module name, quality, price, seller sector. Read-only. Use execute_action MODULE_LISTING_BUY (listing_id) to buy. New modules from the shipyard catalog (module_id, price, slot, buyable): execute_action SHIPYARD_MODULES, then SHIPYARD_BUY_MODULE module_id=<id>.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

name: get_module_listings
